name: @surrealdb/mysql
description: MySQL-dialect client for SurrealDB over HTTP and WebSocket, for serverless, edge and browsers.

scripts.build: tsup && dts-bundle-generator -o dist/index.d.ts src/index.ts --no-check --external-inlines @surrealdb/sql-internal --export-referenced-types false && dts-bundle-generator -o dist/callback.d.ts src/compat/callback.ts --no-check --external-inlines @surrealdb/sql-internal --export-referenced-types false && dts-bundle-generator -o dist/planetscale.d.ts src/planetscale/index.ts --no-check --external-inlines @surrealdb/sql-internal --export-referenced-types false
